metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment outerwear for your team. Soft, breathable prints on jackets and hoodies. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing on outerwear offers a soft hand feel and high detail that traditional screen printing can't match on fabrics like cotton hoodies or fleece jackets. For companies ordering branded outerwear for employee uniforms or event giveaways, DTG allows full-color logos and intricate designs without a heavy ink layer. It works best on light-colored garments and produces a breathable finish that your team will actually want to wear. Perfect for safety managers and HR directors looking for comfortable, professional apparel that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment outerwear featuring a full-color logo on a cotton hoodie, soft and breathable print
